args.title: Warehouse returns tote packing
args.description: Open the hinged lid of a plastic tote, place a rigid carton and a shrink-wrapped pack inside, then close the lid.

steps.description: Hook the tote lid's lip and pull it open.
Pick the rigid carton from the bench and place it in the tote.
Pick the shrink-wrapped pack from the bench and place it in the tote.
Push the tote lid down until it closes.

assumptions: The tote interior is roughly 380x280x180 mm to fit the items.
The lid lip is 12 mm high for hook engagement.
The carton and pack are rigid boxes as described.

args.title: Pipe coupling installation
args.description: Pick a threaded coupling from the bench, start it on the upright pipe spool stub, and tighten it by hand without exceeding 8 N m.

steps.description: Pick the coupling from the bench and lift it.
Align and push the coupling onto the pipe stub.
Turn the coupling clockwise until snug, staying under 8 N m.

assumptions: Coupling outer diameter 40 mm, length 45 mm, metric thread pitch 1.5 mm.
Pipe stub outer diameter matches coupling inner diameter, modeled as a 40 mm diameter cylinder 50 mm long.

warnings: objects[1] (stub): no step acts on it or places into it

grasp_coupling: Threads are an approximation: a helical joint with a torque ramp; no thread flanks, cross-threading or galling. A screen, not a promise.
insert_coupling: Threads are an approximation: a helical joint with a torque ramp; no thread flanks, cross-threading or galling. A screen, not a promise.
tighten_coupling: Threads are an approximation: a helical joint with a torque ramp; no thread flanks, cross-threading or galling. A screen, not a promise.

args.title: Field maintenance on equipment cabinet
args.description: Turn the quarter-turn latch to unlock the door, swing the door open, turn the valve handwheel a quarter open, then grasp and insert the test connector into the service port.

steps.description: Twist the latch head to rotate it toward the unlocked position.
Hook the door handle and pull the door open.
Turn the handwheel valve a quarter turn to open it.
Grasp the test connector plug preparatory to insertion.
Insert the test connector into the service port until seated.

assumptions: The latch requires about 0.8 N·m to overcome its detent.
The cabinet door hinge exerts ~0.3 N·m resisting torque.
The valve handwheel needs ~3 N·m to turn.
The test connector plug is 8 mm diameter and 30 mm long.
The service port depth is 15 mm with 0.2 mm clearance.

unlock_latch: Latches are an approximation: a detent torque on a revolute joint; no cam or spring geometry.
open_valve: Valves are an approximation: a resistive torque curve on a revolute joint; no packing or seat dynamics.

args.title: Valve box maintenance
args.description: Open the hatch of a valve box, close the isolation valve by turning its handwheel one full turn clockwise against about 4 N m torque, then close the hatch.

steps.description: Hook the hatch lip and pull to open the hatch.
Turn the valve handwheel one full turn clockwise to close the isolation valve.
Push the hatch lid to close it.

assumptions: The hatch behaves as a lid with a lip that can be hooked.
The valve handwheel provides about 4 N m resistive torque.
Objects are placed at least 60 mm apart to avoid collision.

close_valve: Valves are an approximation: a resistive torque curve on a revolute joint; no packing or seat dynamics.

args.title: T-shirt handling
args.description: Take a T-shirt from the laundry pile, fold it in thirds on the table and put it in the box.

unsupported.reason: Cloth deformation and folding are not supported primitives; the simulator only handles rigid bodies.

args.refusal: Cannot simulate cloth folding; the core action involves deformable T-shirt manipulation which is outside the supported rigid-body primitives.
